description: Package exists on npm, PyPI or crates.io (hallucinated dependency check) — Checks whether up to 10 package names (optionally with a version) exist in the live npm, PyPI or crates.io registry, for coding agents about to add a dependency they may have invented. Per package: exists, latest version, deprecated or yanked flag, and for a missing name the closest names the registry's own search returns (npm, crates.io; PyPI has no search API). Reads registry metadata only: neve

items.description: At most 5 items for crates.io (its API policy allows one request per second).

version.description: Exact version (npm also accepts a dist-tag).

name: package-exists
